notes.subject: ארך אפים
notes.rationale: Idioma ya Seheberu 'go na le mašufi a marealelelo' — go swana le go šufa ka tšwelopele; kgopolo ya motheo ke 'go šufa ka mašufi'

notes.subject: אפים
notes.rationale: Iphrisha ya motheo ya 'אף' ke 'nose' (diphaka) eupša e bolela mašufi; kgopolo ya motheo ya 'ruakh' le yona e latela 'go hema' — mehla ya 'mašufi' le 'moya' e hloka tshedimoso

translation: Earelele-­mašufi ke tshedimosolo ye ntshi; eupša mokgotšwa wa ruakh o godiša sebe sa bošula.

tokens.gloss: go na le mašufi a marealelelo (go-šufa-ka-tšwelopele)
